	We are a leading provider of heavy lifting solutions, specializing in rentals and sales of mobile cranes, Crawler cranes, spider cranes, and heavy-duty lifting equipment.
	We are seeking for a Business Development Officer who will generate new revenue streams by selling our crane fleet and negotiating rental contracts.

	Identify and prospect new clients requiring crane rentals or purchases for infrastructure, commercial, and industrial projects.

	A Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
	2+ years of experience in marketing, or B.D.O in Real Estate, Logistics, Oil and Gas, Automobile Crane/heavy duty equipment leasing firm.
	Ability to understand crane capabilities(tonnage), boom lengths, and job site logistics.
	A proven track record of cold calling, visiting job sites, and closing deals.
	Must have a proven, documented record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Good understanding of construction machinery and cranes.
	Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.


Salary
N150,000 monthly.

Other Benefits:


	Transportation allowance: NGN 30,000
	Data and Credit allowance: NGN 20,000
	1% commission from crane sales profit.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs and cover letter to: cvs@odixcityconsulting.com.ng using the Job Position as the subject of the email.",

Business Development Officer Job at Odixcity Consulting




        
    

        
        Odixcity Consulting is an International Hr consulting and procurement firm. With expertise in Recruitment & Selection, Performance management, Training & Development, Compensation and benefits as well as Outsourcing of goods and services for organizations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Business Development Officer

Job Location: Lagos and Port Harcourt - Rivers (Hybrid)

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are a leading provider of heavy lifting solutions, specializing in rentals and sales of mobile cranes, Crawler cranes, spider cranes, and heavy-duty lifting equipment.
	We are seeking for a Business Development Officer who will generate new revenue streams by selling our crane fleet and negotiating rental contracts.


Responsibilities


	Identify and prospect new clients requiring crane rentals or purchases for infrastructure, commercial, and industrial projects.
	Conduct site visits to understand client requirements, provide technical consultations, and recommend the right crane for the job.
	Prepare competitive proposals, negotiate rental rates and sales prices, and close agreements that maximize profitability.
	Build long term relationships with construction managers, general contractors, and engineering firms to secure repeat business and long-term contracts.
	Monitor competitor activities and market pricing trends to adjust sales strategies accordingly.
	Work closely with the operations and logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries, mobilizations, on-site safety, and pick up equipment.


Requirements


	A Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
	2+ years of experience in marketing, or B.D.O in Real Estate, Logistics, Oil and Gas, Automobile Crane/heavy duty equipment leasing firm.
	Ability to understand crane capabilities(tonnage), boom lengths, and job site logistics.
	A proven track record of cold calling, visiting job sites, and closing deals.
	Must have a proven, documented record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
	Good understanding of construction machinery and cranes.
	Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.


Salary
N150,000 monthly.

Other Benefits:


	Transportation allowance: NGN 30,000
	Data and Credit allowance: NGN 20,000
	1% commission from crane sales profit.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs and cover letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Human Resources Professional - Construction Industry Job at Pyfinest Resources




        
    

        
        Pyfinest Resources - Our client is a growing and professionally driven Construction and Engineering Services Company delivering civil construction, structural and pipeline works, equipment services, haulage and procurement solutions across Nigeria.

They are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Human Resources Professional - Construction Industry
Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a high-calibre Human Resources Administrator who can move beyond routine administration and take ownership of the company's people, performance, culture and HR systems.
	This is an opportunity for an HR professional who understands that great projects require great people—and great people require great HR leadership.
	You will lead the development and implementation of effective HR strategies that support business growth, operational efficiency and employee performance.
	If you are the kind of HR professional who sees problems before they become crises and can translate people challenges into practical business solutions, this could be your next big move.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition for corporate, technical and project-based roles
	Develop and implement HR policies, procedures and people-management systems
	Drive performance management, KPIs, appraisals and employee development
	Manage employee relations, disciplinary processes and workplace issues professionally
	Ensure accurate personnel records, HR documentation and statutory compliance
	Partner with management on workforce planning, organizational structure and manpower requirements
	Support compensation, benefits, payroll coordination and employee welfare
	Strengthen employee engagement, accountability and organizational culture
	Ensure HR practices align with the company's professional and operational standards
	Provide management with actionable HR reports, insights and recommendations


Requirements
The Ideal Candidate:


	We are looking for an HR professional who combines strong technical HR knowledge with strong emotional intelligence.
	A deep familiarity with the construction industry will be an added advantage.


You should have:


	Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business Administration, Management, or a related field
	Minimum 5 years' progressive HR experience, preferably within Construction, Engineering, Oil & Gas, Procurement or other project-driven environments
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian employment practices and HR administration
	Proven experience managing recruitment, employee relations and performance management
	Strong understanding of HR policies, procedures and organizational development
	Excellent communication, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills
	Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR reporting
	Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and maintain confidentiality
	Professional HR certification such as CIPM, SHRM, or equivalent will be an advantage


We are a Professional HR who can:


	Build structure
	Raise accountability
	Attract talent
	Improve performance
	Strengthen culture
	Advise management.


Why This Opportunity Stands Out


	Salary: N250,000 monthly. 
	Work within a growing engineering and construction environment
	Opportunity to build and strengthen HR systems
	Direct impact on organizational growth and workforce performance
	Strategic exposure to management
	Opportunity to shape the people function of a growing Nigerian business
	Competitive remuneration package.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using “Human Resources Professional – Port Harcourt” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only candidates with relevant HR management experience will be shortlisted.

Social Media Manager Job at Pulse Nigeria




        
    

        
        Pulse is Africa’s leading innovative media company, informing and engaging Africa’s young audience - and providing expansive media reach and creative marketing solutions to partners. We run news websites and social channels and marketing and production across Francophone and Anglophone West Africa and East Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Social Media Manager

Job Location: Maryland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time (Hybrid)

Responsibilties
News Sourcing & Publishing:
     

            
    




	Monitor local and global news, trends, and conversations in real time to identify fast-breaking stories worth posting
	Draft and publish timely, accurate social posts across platforms (Instagram, X/Twitter, Facebook, TikTok, etc.) within tight turnaround windows
	Coordinate with the editorial/content desk to verify facts before publishing


Content Ideation:


	Generate original content ideas (not just repackaged news) that reflect Pulse's voice and audience interests
	Pitch formats, series, and trends the team should jump on
	Collaborate with the Storytelling and Amplification units to bring ideas to life.


Advertising & Sponsored Content:


	Schedule and publish paid/sponsored posts and ad creatives per brand and client specifications
	Ensure ads are tagged, formatted, and posted correctly across all relevant pages
	Track posting deadlines for advertiser deliverables.


Event Coverage:


	Receive and review video content from the Event Coverage team for social media publishing.
	Coordinate with the Event Coverage team to understand the event schedule, key moments, available content and publishing priorities.
	Publish event content across relevant social media platforms in line with the agreed content plan and timing.
	Ensure event coverage is posted promptly and consistently while maintaining platform-specific formats and standards.


Community Engagement:


	Monitor comments, DMs, and mentions; respond promptly and in Pulse's tone of voice
	Flag trending conversations, complaints, or opportunities to the wider team
	Foster and grow an active, engaged online community.


Reporting:


	Track post performance (reach, engagement, video views, follower growth) across platforms
	Compile weekly/monthly performance reports with key wins, learnings, and recommendations
	Flag underperforming content patterns and suggest adjustments


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree or relevant experience in Marketing, Communications, Media, Public Relations, or a related field.
	2–4 years of experience in social media management, content creation, community management, or a similar role.
	Strong knowledge of major social media platforms like Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, Twitter and their respective best practices.
	Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills.
	Strong understanding of social media analytics and performance metrics.
	Experience with content creation tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms.
	Ability to develop creative content ideas and translate them into engaging social media posts.
	Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
	Knowledge of current social media trends and digital marketing practices.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary based on experience.
	Hybrid work mode
	Data or airtime monthly allowance.

	Create graphics, reels, and short-form videos

	Develop creative content ideas and social media strategies.


Requirements

	Good knowledge of Canva, CapCut, or similar tools
	Strong communication and creative skills
	Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.


Salary
N70,000 - N100,000 / month.
